comment.body:
[Note: The caption says, “Israel is God’s,” but that is absolutely incorrect. Listen closely. He pronounces no “s” at the end. He says, very clearly, “Israel is God!”]

Here is why we need to abandon the whole bullshit notion of "authority".

No, this isn't merely taking the idea of authority to an obscene extreme.

1. The impetus to head in this obscene direction is inherent in the core notion of "authority".

2. There is nothing to stop people, once they've head in this extreme direction, from going all the way. In fact, the motivation to keep going further and further into megalomania IS INHERENT to the core notion.

If Israel, at this point, (along with hundreds of other examples from history, along with your personal experience with the authorities you've had contact with,) doesn't convince you that authority always wants and wills and tries to find a way to become megalomaniacal, then either you're dense or perverse, and demonstrable fact as well as history stand against you.
